tool_input.summary: Fixed the formula in K6. The original formula IF((@$A$3:$A$8=$I3)*(@$B$3:$B$8=$J3),C3,0) had two issues: (1) it used IF which only returns a single value (C3) rather than summing all matching rows, and (2) it didn't multiply by the C column values. Replaced with =SUMPRODUCT(($A$3:$A$8=$I3)*($B$3:$B$8=$J3)*$C$3:$C$8) which correctly sums the net profit from the first table where Year matches I3 (2012) and Share No matches J3 (101010), yielding -10600.
